meta.name: spec-workflow
meta.description: Use when medium-to-large changes need explicit requirements, technical design, and task planning before implementation, especially for multi-module work, unclear acceptance criteria, or architecture-heavy requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编码前明确需求、设计与任务计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果变更涉及多模块、架构复杂或验收标准不清晰
copy.tagline_en: Clarify requirements, design, and task planning before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if changes involve multiple modules, complex architecture, or unclear acceptance criteria

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你依次写需求文档、设计文档和任务列表，确认后才开始编码。产出三个文件：requirements.md、design.md、tasks.md。
howto.when: 当你提出新功能、跨模块变更或架构设计等中大型需求，且验收标准不明确时触发。

say.text: 我要增加一个支付模块，请帮我做需求分析和设计。
say.note: 触发完整的需求-设计-任务流程。

say.text: 设计一个订单系统的数据库表结构，并生成任务列表。
say.note: 跳过需求直接进入设计阶段？需确认。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will guide you to write requirements, design, and task breakdown documents, then start coding only after confirmation. Outputs: requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose a medium-to-large change like a new feature, cross-module work, or architectural design, especially with unclear acceptance criteria.

say_en.text: I need to add a payment module. Please do requirements analysis and design.
Design database tables for an order system and generate task list.
